TRAINER_VIOLET.assessment: Aerilate Tropius contributes Tailwind and physical pressure while Comfey can develop a Triage recovery offense. Roserade adds sleep and Tsareena shuts down opposing priority. The reserve roles make the opening's setup cost defensible without homogenizing the team.

TRAINER_CAMERON_1.assessment: Solrock establishes Trick Room beside slow Alolan Exeggutor. Hatterene protects the reserve phase against reflected status, and Power Herb Lunatone gives one immediate Meteor Beam burst. The entire offensive plan coheres with the deliberately low Speed investment.

TRAINER_JACKI_1.assessment: Musharna supplies paralysis, screens and Helping Hand beside Armor Tail Farigiraf's special attacks. Espeon and Jynx retain offensive Psychic identity while adding status reflection and sleep. This is a protection-and-control team, not a delayed introductory puzzle.

TRAINER_MIU_AND_YUKI.assessment: Drought Ninetales and Chlorophyll Weepinbell form the coherent opening. Alolan Ninetales offers an intentional second weather mode, and Torterra uses partner-safe Ground coverage in either state. Preserve the unusual twin-weather identity with ordered entry.

TRAINER_FREDRICK.assessment: Aegislash protects against spread damage while Comfey establishes Trick Room or heals. Milotic deters stat drops and can Haze opponents before Mega Tyranitar's slow sand finish. Haze does not erase any authored friendly setup here, which supports retaining the move.

TRAINER_ALBERTO.assessment: Pelipper's rain and Tailwind make Altaria's Hurricane practical. Xatu supplies physical damage reduction and Corviknight brings a bulkier reserve line. Weather and speed support serve both the immediate pair and later attackers.

TRAINER_ED.assessment: Seviper's Glare buys turns for Toxic Orb Zangoose, including its explicit Protect activation. Glaceon has an independent Snowscape/Slush Rush mode and Roserade supplies sleep rather than redundant physical damage. Preserve the rivals-and-rarities collector identity.

TRAINER_KAYLEY.assessment: Castform's manual sun enables Sawsbuck's fast physical pressure and boosts Mega Charizard X's Fire damage. Emolga's Electric immunity and Encore complement the offensive trio. Sawsbuck's availability is a player-acquisition dependency, not a reason to delete it here.

TRAINER_JAZMYN.assessment: Absol leads immediate Dark pressure beside a Toxic Orb/Poison Heal Goodra that invests offensively. Jolteon supplies paralysis and pivoting; Mega Lucario adds a second priority attack and Adaptability finish. Keep the balanced four with deliberately different defensive responses.

TRAINER_DAVIS.assessment: Orbeetle's dual screens protect Moxie Pinsir and the later Quiver Dance bugs. Feint can turn a predicted Protect into momentum; Masquerain also gives Intimidate on entry. Retain the intentionally defensive investment on Dustox because its win condition accumulates boosts.

TRAINER_FERNANDO_1.assessment: Zebstrika's special burst and Volt Switch pair with Kricketune's Taunt. Dedenne converts Super Fang and Helping Hand into support, while Balloon Togedemaru offers a physically distinct reserve. Both Lightning Rod users reward careful switching but do not protect against Ground.

TRAINER_SPENSER_FORTREE.assessment: Crobat's Tailwind, Taunt and Haze support an honest Truant Slaking burst. Lapras and Arcanine diversify damage and control; Venusaur and Mega Mawile preserve Spenser's recognizable ace relationships. The existing Crobat/Slaking/Lapras core already supplies nostalgia and should remain.

TRAINER_JARED.assessment: Noctowl's Tinted Lens and Simple Swoobat's Calm Mind form a high-pressure special opening. Scyther, Fearow, Swellow and Crobat pivot into physical offense; their items make each reserve useful. Keep the species mix but replace dismissive, mechanically overbroad counterplay prose.

TRAINER_EDWARDO.assessment: Honchkrow seeks a Moxie opening with Jumpluff sleep or Encore support. Vespiquen supplies a bulky pivot, Mandibuzz restores Tailwind, Toucannon breaks fragile targets with multihit coverage and Braviary punishes stat drops. Preserve the deliberate escalation in reserve offensive strength.

TRAINER_FLINT.assessment: Yanmega and itemless Archeops attack immediately, with every teammate airborne for authored Earthquake partnerships. Flygon offers a Scarf mode; Dragonite and Mega Salamence supply separate setup finishes. Preserve the sky-and-dragon composition and safe Ground spread structure.

TRAINER_ASHLEY.assessment: Pelipper's rain and Tailwind support multiple Hurricane users. Ninjask adds physical setup; Cramorant retains Surf specifically for Gulp Missile, with Hydro Pump as the safe alternative. Mega Pidgeot offers accuracy independent of weather, so retain the multi-mode aerial identity.

TRAINER_HUMBERTO.assessment: Gliscor and Corviknight supply a physically durable opening with safe Earthquake use. Fan Rotom burns, Archeops supplies Scarf pressure, Hawlucha activates Unburden through White Herb Close Combat and Sigilyph attacks without Life Orb recoil. Retain the well-connected airborne roster.

TRAINER_DARIUS.assessment: Prankster Tornadus enables Specs Hisuian Braviary immediately. Tropius sustains, Unfezant supplies physical pressure, Togekiss converts speed advantage into disruption and Mega Aerodactyl closes. All members are airborne for the ace's Earthquake.

TRAINER_WINONA_1.assessment: Altaria is already a substantive signature Pokémon: it supports Zapdos with Tailwind and Helping Hand and can recover. Enamorus supplies Contrary physical snowballing, Talonflame immediate priority, Noivern special burst and Mega Skarmory a defensive finish. Preserve this authored identity rather than replace its legendary partners.

TRAINER_GABBY_AND_TY_4.assessment: Meltan and Magnezone create a slower technological interview opening, with paralysis and Sturdy enabling the familiar Exploud/Sylveon sound reserves. Meltan's narrow legal role is deliberate; do not replace it just for stronger stats. Its evolution path remains an acquisition issue elsewhere.

TRAINER_WALTER_1.assessment: Intimidate Luxray enables Regenerator Slowking's bulky Trick Room; the Brave attackers use its turns and Alomomola offers Helping Hand or Safeguard. Preserve slow, defensively supported physical pressure rather than normalize the team's offensive investment.

TRAINER_TAMMY.assessment: Banette combines immediate physical threats with Destiny Bond beside special Pixilate Mismagius. Spiritomb supplies burn/Snarl control and Dusknoir a slower Choice Band finish. This is a coherent ghost collector that does not require every slot to be fast.

TRAINER_KATE_AND_JOY.assessment: Neutralizing Gas Weezing and Choice Scarf Slaking form the defining engine. The revised High Horsepower is partner-safe; Kangaskhan and Stoutland provide useful physical reserves when the gas core ends. Keep this textbook dangerous combination with a clear target-priority puzzle.

TRAINER_JESSICA_1.assessment: Scrappy Lopunny buys Milotic recovery or attack turns with Fake Out. Froslass threatens burns and Destiny Bond; Skill Link Cinccino provides multihit reserve pressure. Retain the polished beauty team and Milotic's deliberate defensive investment.

TRAINER_CALE.assessment: Frosmoth's special resilience and Quiver Dance pair with Centiskorch's immediate physical Fire Lash pressure. Leavanny can restore speed advantage through Electroweb, and Intimidate Vespiquen protects the attackers while offering Helping Hand. Keep the uncommon bugs' distinct contributions.

TRAINER_MYLES.assessment: Togekiss redirects beside Lucario's immediate pressure; Magmortar offers special burst, Serperior escalates through Contrary, Miltank supports and Whiscash can finish through Dragon Dance. Preserve this breeder's diverse fully raised roster.

TRAINER_PAT.assessment: Feraligatr and Reckless Bouffalant establish physical pressure. Electivire provides Electroweb, Mega Sceptile supplies a fast special mode, Simisear adds mixed coverage and Lycanroc closes with priority. The actual roster is coherent; the plan incorrectly names absent Tropius and Tailwind.

TRAINER_MARCEL.assessment: Zeraora attacks beside Shiftry's Fake Out/Tailwind mode. Special Shiftry still benefits from Wind Rider's wind immunity while its Attack boost is incidental; Stoutland provides Intimidate and Haxorus a Lum-protected setup finish. Preserve the mixed attacking distribution.

TRAINER_CRISTIN_1.assessment: Regieleki's Electric speed pressure and Ninetales's sun form a direct opening. Mega Flygon adds sound-converted Ground coverage and Tailwind; Chlorophyll Lilligant supplies sleep or Helping Hand. Preserve the custom Mega's explicit role and the real cross-type coverage.

TRAINER_GABBY_AND_TY_5.assessment: Scarf Toxtricity attacks beside Overcoat Kommo-o's Body Press setup. Primarina supplies Liquid Voice spread damage and Altaria supplies Cloud Nine plus Tailwind. The current plan's Soundproof Kommo-o and Hyper Voice Altaria are stale; Overdrive is already partner-safe.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_LILYCOVE_MUDKIP.assessment: Swellow and Manectric supply the established rival opening; Breloom and Mimikyu retain disruption. Mega Metagross provides the branch-specific Steel/Psychic attacker while ordinary Sceptile remains the starter ace. Preserve the familiar ensemble and safe Stomping Tantrum.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_LILYCOVE_TORCHIC.assessment: This branch retains Swellow/Manectric initiative with Breloom and Mimikyu disruption, then Mega Salamence's setup and ordinary Swampert's sturdy physical finish. The two reserves cover different defensive answers and High Horsepower keeps Swampert partner-safe.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_LILYCOVE_TREECKO.assessment: The familiar rival opening precedes Mega Tyranitar and Speed Boost Blaziken. Breloom supplies Spore and Mimikyu utility. Preserve the strong sand-and-speed reserve contrast, while acknowledging sand can break Manectric's Sash and chip teammates.

TRAINER_MAY_LILYCOVE_MUDKIP.assessment: May's Sceptile branch independently matches the authored familiar four and Mega Metagross reserve, with all loadouts preserved. This gender counterpart needs its own script binding verified even though the competitive team equals Brendan's counterpart.

TRAINER_MAY_LILYCOVE_TORCHIC.assessment: May's Swampert branch retains Mega Salamence as its separate setup threat. Breloom's recovery disruption and Mimikyu's Disguise utility maintain the rivalry's recognizable core. Keep identical competitive parity with Brendan while validating this distinct trainer identifier.

TRAINER_MAY_LILYCOVE_TREECKO.assessment: May's Blaziken branch independently retains Mega Tyranitar's sand and the Speed Boost starter finish. The authored rivalry remains recognizable without turning the starter into the Mega slot. Keep this branch's exact parity with its Brendan counterpart.

TRAINER_GABBY_AND_TY_6.assessment: Specs Exploud's Boomburst is intentionally paired with Telepathy Noivern, and Telepathy Gardevoir can replace it safely. Sylveon instead needs Hyper Voice support. This is an excellent finale to the reporter sound identity, with a consequential reserve/Choice-lock interaction.

TRAINER_BUFFEL.assessment: Mienshao's Fake Out and pivoting support Mega Milotic's defensive opening. Haxorus, Klinklang and Volcarona supply three different setup modes behind Togekiss redirection. Preserve the custom Mega's special-damage cushioning and the resulting physical counterplay.

TRAINER_MARK.assessment: Weakness Policy Rhyperior and Sheer Force Druddigon provide a bulky physical opening. Lickilicky suppresses weather and offers Helping Hand; Garchomp supplies a faster protected finish. Preserve the deliberate Policy threat without falsely forbidding lethal super-effective attacks.

TRAINER_DEZ_AND_LUKE.assessment: Steelix's Wide Guard and Defense-based Body Press support Cloyster's Shell Smash. Golurk supplies protected physical coverage and Palossand punishes surviving Water hits through Water Compaction plus Weakness Policy. Keep the distinct defensive responses across the quartet.

TRAINER_LEAH.assessment: Gengar's Icy Wind and special attacks are supported by Dusknoir's burns/Helping Hand. Spiritomb adds Snarl/Foul Play and Banette physical Ghost pressure. There is no Trick Room in this roster, so its alleged internal speed conflict is obsolete prose.

TRAINER_ZANDER.assessment: Hariyama's Fake Out enables Hitmonlee's Close Combat/White Herb/Unburden route. Machamp adds No Guard pressure and Wide Guard; mixed Lucario supplies special Steel coverage and Extreme Speed. Preserve distinct contributions within the Fighting identity.

TRAINER_WILLIAM.assessment: Beheeyem's paralysis and Ally Switch support Gardevoir's Calm Mind. Sharpness Gallade contributes physical cutting attacks and Mr. Mime Icy Wind. The lineup is coherent but its blanket Dark weakness is incorrect for the dual-typed members.

TRAINER_KAYLA.assessment: Hypno establishes Room beside offensive Hatterene; Wobbuffet can trap and punish chosen attack categories, with Grumpig as another slow special reserve. This is a coherent confined-board puzzle rather than a generic Psychic lineup.

TRAINER_GABRIELLE_1.assessment: Avalugg and Triage Meganium form the true opening, with healing supporting physical durability. Alolan Raichu and Gorebyss each have independent field modes, Donphan provides safe physical coverage and Mega Abomasnow brings snow later. The team is coherent; the plan wrongly implies Abomasnow leads and Donphan spins.

TRAINER_ATSUSHI.assessment: Samurott's Swords Dance and Aqua Jet create a setup threat alongside No Guard Machamp's immediate disruption and Wide Guard. Hariyama reintroduces Fake Out and Basculin supplies Choice Band Adaptability priority. Preserve the martial-and-Water identity.

TRAINER_TASHA.assessment: Chandelure's Room aligns with Brave Banette and Trevenant; Spiritomb contributes support without needing high Speed. Flash Fire gives Chandelure a useful switch-in against attacks aimed at Trevenant. Preserve a consistent slow Ghost strategy.

TRAINER_VALERIE_1.assessment: Prankster Sableye's Fake Out, Quash and Encore create openings for Drifblim's burn/Hex offense. Dusknoir adds Helping Hand and Gengar supplies faster special damage. No member carries Trick Room, so the old Room counterplay is a documentation defect.

TRAINER_CEDRIC.assessment: Bronzong establishes Room beside Reuniclus's recoil-free Life Orb offense. Oranguru then offers Instruct; Mr. Rime adds slow Ice coverage. The intended repeated attack depends on actual move order, not merely putting Instruct in the party.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_1.assessment: Muk's Knock Off/Helping Hand supports Hustle Alolan Raticate's damage, while Tentacruel adds Icy Wind and Mightyena a Choice Band/Intimidate finish. This four-member faction team remains dangerous with ordinary species and clear utility.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_2.assessment: Scarf Bruxish and Weavile's Fake Out establish immediate tempo. Wailord later provides rain and HP-sensitive spread damage; Antique Polteageist supplies a White Herb Shell Smash route. These are separate credible modes, not unsupported opening weather claims.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_3.assessment: Amoonguss protects Jellicent's Trick Room and Water Spout through sleep/redirection. Volt Absorb Lanturn covers Electric pressure and Golisopod offers an immediately threatening First Impression reserve. Keep the defensive Water-core puzzle.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_PYRE_4.assessment: Carracosta's Wide Guard or Rock Gem pressure works with Liepard's Fake Out and Prankster disruption. Qwilfish supplies Intimidate/Icy Wind and Drapion higher-critical-rate attacks. Preserve the core's distinct protection and damage routes.

TRAINER_MATT_MT_PYRE.assessment: Pelipper's rain supports Okidogi's bulky physical opening and several distinct reserve beneficiaries. Toxicroak adds Fake Out, Seismitoad adds Swift Swim, Heliolisk supplies accurate Thunder and Mega Golisopod a priority-heavy finish. Preserve the gang's strong thematic composition.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_1.assessment: Swalot's Yawn creates opportunities for Camerupt's special spread pressure. Alolan Persian gives fast Fake Out and damage reduction; Houndoom offers a faster Fire mode and burns. Sticky Hold and Fur Coat have meaningful defensive roles despite ordinary species.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2.assessment: Hippowdon activates Sandslash's Sand Rush immediately. Gastrodon protects against single-target Water while Kabutops offers an independent Weak Armor/White Herb or Swords Dance finish. Preserve safe Ground moves and the coherent sand core.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_14.assessment: Stakeout Thievul and Salazzle combine switch punishment with Fake Out/Encore. Nidoqueen supplies concentrated special damage and Talonflame a late Tailwind or physical pivot. Keep this aggressive disruption-based quartet.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3.assessment: Claydol's Room supports Brave Garbodor and slow Camerupt; Umbreon supplies Yawn and Snarl. Toxic Spikes is a situational attrition option against a full player bench, not the default first turn. Retain it with explicitly board-aware AI selection.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_4.assessment: Scrafty's Fake Out and Intimidate support Galarian Slowking's immediate special pressure. Simple Magcargo offers an explosive White Herb Shell Smash mode and Houndoom a separate Nasty Plot route. Keep this unusually threatening ordinary grunt.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_5.assessment: Defiant Bisharp discourages physical mitigation while Venomoth sets up behind that threat. Heatmor lowers Defense for the physical core and Krookodile supplies a safe Moxie finish. Preserve the complementary special and physical plans.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_15.assessment: Krookodile's Intimidate/Taunt enables Victreebel's sleep or Petaya offense. Incineroar supplies another controlled pivot and Golem offers a Sturdy/Policy punish. Preserve the highly competent faction team and partner-safe Ground attacks.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_6.assessment: Infernape's Fake Out enables Ariados to redirect or establish Sticky Web. Magmortar supplies stronger special spread pressure and Turtonator a durable reserve. Web has a plausible full-player-party role but costs a turn and does not affect airborne entries.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_7.assessment: Skuntank applies Taunt and priority beside Weezing's burns and Levitate. Larvesta adds a physically sturdy Eviolite pivot, and Coalossal can punish an opponent's Fire attack through Steam Engine. No friendly activation is required for Coalossal's reserve role.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_8.assessment: Mightyena contributes Intimidate, priority and optional Howl beside special Tailwind Flygon. Pyroar adds Competitive/Throat Spray special escalation and Sandaconda a physical reserve. Howl is useful for Mightyena or Sandaconda but does not boost the special attackers.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_9.assessment: Honchkrow supports slow Camerupt with Tailwind and Taunt. Special Shiftry provides Fake Out and wind immunity, while Choice Band Darmanitan is the major fast physical reserve. Preserve the distinct lead and reserve contributions.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_16.assessment: Gliscor sets Tailwind while Unaware Dustox builds resilient Quiver Dance pressure. Chandelure adds Fire immunity and special spread damage; Assault Vest Drapion offers a slower physical route. Retain the anti-setup identity instead of replacing the modest bug.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_10.assessment: Cacturne deters Water targeting beside mixed Intimidate Arcanine. Palossand supplies recovery and Water Compaction while Clefable redirects with Unaware. The reserves reinforce survival without removing the opening's priority pressure.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_11.assessment: Mandibuzz's Tailwind/Taunt supports Life Orb Mamoswine immediately. Scolipede can generate independent Speed and Delcatty supplies reserve Fake Out, paralysis and Helping Hand. Preserve the support-only reserve's deliberate purpose beside real attackers.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_12.assessment: Prankster Sableye enables Torkoal's HP-dependent Eruption through Fake Out or Quash. Excadrill and Garchomp offer partner-safe Ground damage in reserve. The existing team is an expert-level engine; the plan's Earthquake reference is stale.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_13.assessment: Amoonguss protects Weakness Policy Rhyperior, with Pangoro providing healing/pivot pressure and Tauros Intimidate plus faster damage. Preserve the powerful redirection/slow-attacker opening and ordinary-species identity.

TRAINER_TABITHA_MAGMA_HIDEOUT.assessment: Physical Dragapult's low-investment Surf deliberately activates Coalossal's Policy and Steam Engine; Volcanion is a compatible Water Absorb reserve. Gigalith/Sandaconda supply a later sand mode and Mega Golurk a physical finish. Preserve this authored engine pending exact damage/order verification rather than replace it casually.

TRAINER_COURTNEY_MAGMA_HIDEOUT.assessment: Ninetales and Chi-Yu form an immediately dangerous sun/special-pressure opening. Great Tusk adds a physical Protosynthesis beneficiary, Salazzle disrupts and poisons otherwise resistant targets, and Mega Pyroar finishes with spread sound. Preserve Courtney's precise Fire identity and exceptional roster.

TRAINER_MAXIE_MAGMA_HIDEOUT.assessment: Groudon and Crobat establish Maxie's sun-and-Tailwind identity, with Mightyena and Mega Camerupt preserving his familiar Pokémon. Victreebel uses Chlorophyll sleep and Hydreigon supplies special Dragon pressure. This already satisfies the main nostalgia objective without sacrificing power.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_1.assessment: Tentacruel's Icy Wind supports Dhelmise's slow physical pressure. Eviolite Poipole supplies Helping Hand and special coverage; Water Veil Wailord offers a later HP-sensitive attack without overwriting weather. Preserve the exotic helper and anchor identity.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_2.assessment: Sharpedo gains Speed while Dragalge supplies immediate Adaptability pressure; Overqwil adds Intimidate and Crawdaunt a Choice Band priority finish. The quartet mixes fast frailty with slow special force instead of assuming all fish share weaknesses.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_3.assessment: Scrafty's Fake Out/Intimidate supports Seismitoad's spread offense. Drednaw adds White Herb Shell Smash, while Toxapex's Acid Spray can support special attacks and Surf can heal Water Absorb Seismitoad. Keep this explicit conditional friendly interaction.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_5.assessment: Politoed enables immediate Swift Swim Barraskewda offense and Helping Hand. Kilowattrel adds rain-accurate Thunder/Hurricane plus Tailwind, while Jellicent offers defensive recovery pressure. Preserve the rain team; Damp Rock contradicts the five-turn prose.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_7.assessment: Cloyster's Shell Smash combines with Kingler's immediate physical damage. Thievul punishes switching and Propeller Tail Barraskewda offers a Choice Band reserve that can bypass redirection. Keep the complementary setup and switch-punishment choices.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_4.assessment: Crobat's Taunt/pivoting supports Mega Launcher Clawitzer's special pressure. Alolan Muk develops through Curse and Gluttony while Mega Eelektross supplies physical reserve pressure. The team is coherent, but the plan overlooks its Mega and misstates Muk's Fighting weakness.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_6.assessment: Toxicroak supplies Fake Out beside Toxapex's Wide Guard and recovery. Wishiwashi brings the stronger special offense and Falinks can commit to No Retreat. Haze is absent, appropriately preserving friendly boosts; repair the stale plan rather than adding it back.

TRAINER_GRUNT_AQUA_HIDEOUT_8.assessment: Relicanth's Rock Head pressure is supported by Vileplume's sleep and Strength Sap. Mismagius adds fast disruption and Gyarados a Lum-protected Dragon Dance reserve. Preserve the dual attack modes and the familiar Aqua ace.

TRAINER_MATT.assessment: Politoed/Specs Kingdra lead an excellent rain core, Basculegion supplies physical burst, Archaludon uses immediate Electro Shot, Grimmsnarl screens and Mega Malamar supplies Contrary pressure. Preserve the team; its published counterplay contains substantial typing errors.

TRAINER_JENNY_1.assessment: Wailord establishes rain beside fast Starmie coverage. Primarina provides Throat Spray/Liquid Voice pressure and Lapras Freeze-Dry plus a second Icy Wind source. Preserve the coherent special Water team and meaningful anti-Water coverage.

TRAINER_GRACE.assessment: Lanturn's coverage and Icy Wind enable Gorebyss's manual rain; Vikavolt adds another control option and Whiscash combines Rindo protection with rain Hydration. Preserve the layered Electric immunities and separate rain setter.

TRAINER_LILA_AND_ROY_1.assessment: East Gastrodon supplies Icy Wind and Storm Drain while Eviolite Nidorina uses Hustle offense or Helping Hand. Clawitzer and Dragalge turn that support into strong special reserve damage. Keep the modest opening species and deliberately stronger reserves.

TRAINER_DECLAN.assessment: Intimidate Gyarados sets up beside Fur Coat Dewgong's speed control and Encore. Swampert supplies immediate safe Ground damage and Omastar another White Herb setup mode. Preserve the physically resilient water puzzle.

TRAINER_ISABELLA.assessment: Mantine's Helping Hand supports Belly Drum Azumarill and later special Greninja or mixed Arctovish. The opening is dangerous because Sitrus restores HP after Drum and Aqua Jet bypasses ordinary Speed. Preserve the combo and correct the oversimplified half-HP vulnerability.

TRAINER_STAN.assessment: Manual-rain Kingdra supports its own Swift Swim while Simple Bibarel threatens a +4 Swords Dance. Poison Heal Goodra offers accurate Thunder in rain and Ludicolo can refresh weather. Keep the unusual early-family powerhouse as a genuine threat.

TRAINER_TANYA.assessment: Soul-Heart Luvdisc can snowball through faints while Alomomola supports it. Vaporeon offers another Helping Hand/spread mode and Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops. Luvdisc's fast invested Icy Wind invalidates dismissive blanket claims about team Speed.

TRAINER_ERNEST_1.assessment: Guts Conkeldurr and Golisopod threaten immediate priority from different types. Walrein supplies durable special coverage and Encore; Ninjask can pass earned Speed Boost stages into a stronger partner. Preserve Walrein's useful presence and the deliberate reserve support.

TRAINER_KIM_AND_IRIS.assessment: Cloud Nine Altaria supplies Tailwind beside Policy Rhyperior; Cryogonal's Freeze-Dry and Wash Rotom's burns give the reserves speed and physical control. Preserve the weather-independent mixed core with safe Ground coverage.

TRAINER_PRESLEY.assessment: Scarf Staraptor's Final Gambit or pivoting can remove an obstacle for Poison Heal Gliscor. The all-airborne reserves permit Earthquake; Farfetch'd offers Feint and Braviary Choice Band pressure. Keep the physically aggressive aerial quartet.

TRAINER_AURON.assessment: Mixed Lucario pressures both defenses with Vaporeon's spread damage or Helping Hand. Regenerator Corsola supplies Icy Wind/recovery and Scarf Jolteon a fast special pivot. Preserve the balanced Expert with a meaningful unusual support species.

TRAINER_BARRY.assessment: Swampert's immediate attacks pair with Sap Sipper Gogoat's recovery/setup. Dewgong supports through Icy Wind/Encore and Gyarados provides Intimidate plus another setup mode. Preserve the deliberate Grass-immunity switch option.

TRAINER_DEAN.assessment: Haxorus attacks while Ludicolo establishes rain or supplies special coverage. Quagsire adds Yawn and Water immunity; Poison Heal Goodra uses rain-accurate Thunder. Keep the mixed Dragon/Water balance and conditional weather mode.

TRAINER_NIKKI.assessment: Lapras supplies Freeze-Dry and Icy Wind beside Audino's Wish/Helping Hand. Hustle Zweilous provides physical reserve damage and Swanna a faster special option. Preserve the underused middle evolution and support-focused opening.

TRAINER_BRENDA.assessment: Glaceon's manual snow provides its own speed control beside Octillery's coverage. Water Veil Seaking supplies physical reserve offense and Alomomola Helping Hand/Safeguard. The roster works; the plan falsely grants Seaking Lightning Rod.

TRAINER_SIENNA.assessment: Damp Rock Politoed supports Swift Swim Huntail's White Herb Shell Smash. Hydration Whiscash supplies a physical setup reserve and Vaporeon adds spread damage/support. Preserve the strongly committed rain puzzle with several viable attacker choices.

TRAINER_PABLO_1.assessment: Kabutops's Weak Armor and Golduck's weather suppression lead; Qwilfish offers Intimidate/Icy Wind and Mantine supports through Helping Hand. This team can contest weather teams without a setter of its own.

TRAINER_CAMDEN.assessment: Klinklang's Shift Gear and Greninja's coverage make the opening, followed by Azumarill's priority setup and mixed Arctovish. Preserve the two setup routes; modern configured Protean does not provide unrestricted type changes every turn.

TRAINER_DONNY.assessment: Yanmega can give Blastoise Tailwind or immediate damage while gaining its own Speed Boost. Pyukumuku's Helping Hand and Soak support a real attacker; Basculin supplies an Adaptability finish. Retain the unusual support species with board-aware use.

TRAINER_HENRY.assessment: Tentacruel's Acid Spray directly enables Jellicent's Water Spout or Shadow Ball. Chatot and Fletchinder are reserve Tailwind setters, with the latter adding burns. Preserve two opportunities to establish speed control, not the obsolete claim of stacking Tailwind.

TRAINER_ROGER.assessment: Crawdaunt threatens Swords Dance beside contact-boosted Mega Kingler. Crabominable adds powerful slower punches and Scarf Dracovish pressures action order. Preserve the hard-hitting crab identity and surprising reserve.

TRAINER_ATHENA.assessment: Mixed Infernape and HP-invested Accelgor create immediate offense or Final Gambit pressure. Pheromosa offers fast mixed damage and Mega Kangaskhan Fake Out plus a physical finish. Preserve the exotic Ace team without dismissing its members' survival.

TRAINER_KOJI_1.assessment: Hariyama enables Sturdy Aggron's powerful attacks with Fake Out. Basculin adds immediate Choice Band priority and Togekiss can redirect or paralyze in reserve. Preserve the high-quality ordinary Fighting/Steel opening and later support route.

TRAINER_ISAIAH_1.assessment: Dodrio's Swords Dance is supported by Jolteon's paralysis or pivot pressure. Mantine can amplify damage with Helping Hand and Lickilicky supplies weather suppression plus a Normal Gem strike. Keep the sharply different reserve roles.

TRAINER_KATELYN_1.assessment: Intimidate Fearow and Lightning Rod Zebstrika form a coherent opening, with Butterfree offering accurate powders/Tailwind and Galarian Corsola physical denial. Preserve the modest species supported by serious competitive roles.

TRAINER_ALEXA.assessment: Feraligatr's Dragon Dance accompanies Thick Club Alolan Marowak's immediate physical force. Scizor adds priority, Exeggutor sleep/recovery, Ampharos speed control and Mega Diancie a mixed finish. Preserve the diverse six and Diamond Storm's genuine defensive payoff.

TRAINER_RUBEN.assessment: Triage Meganium protects Heatmor through healing/screens, with Dragonite's Multiscale setup and Lopunny Fake Out as later modes. Milotic controls speed and Mega Latias adds Tailwind plus special pressure. Keep multiple support paths rather than replace uncommon Heatmor.

TRAINER_HARRISON.assessment: Lickilicky's weather suppression and immediate Normal Gem damage support Omastar's Shell Smash. Simple Bibarel offers another setup-plus-priority route and Floatzel straightforward physical pressure. Preserve the compact weather-independent puzzle.

TRAINER_CARLEE.assessment: Drampa's Berserk spread damage is supported by Alomomola; Palafin must pivot to unlock its stronger form before the team runs out of switch targets, while Octillery supplies coverage. Preserve the support opening with an explicit Zero to Hero reserve policy.

TRAINER_PRESTON.assessment: Xatu's Tailwind/status reflection supports Harvest Exeggutor; Slowking, Hypno and Grumpig provide resilient control before Mega Alakazam's finish. The actual opener and Mega ability differ from the plan: Alakazam has Magic Guard before Mega and Trace afterward.

TRAINER_VIRGIL.assessment: Bronzong establishes Room beside Musharna, with Eviolite Dusclops adding burns and fixed damage. Chimecho sustains, Claydol supplies coverage and fast Mega Medicham provides an alternative finish outside Room. Preserve the deliberate two-speed structure.

TRAINER_BLAKE.assessment: Female Meowstic's Competitive screens support Eviolite Metang, while Klefki offers paralysis and hazards. Mr. Rime correctly uses Tangled Feet to preserve screens; Girafarig supplies coverage and Ghost immunity. Retain the coherent support/attacker structure.

TRAINER_HANNAH.assessment: Bruxish and Contrary Malamar lead physical pressure; Veluza and Mega Gallade retain the cutting theme. Espathra and Rabsca are real special reserves, so physical mitigation alone cannot cover the team. Preserve mixed-category contingency.

TRAINER_SAMANTHA.assessment: Espeon's screens protect Shadow Tag Gothitelle, while Reuniclus can establish a later Room phase for Beheeyem. Grimmsnarl contributes priority control and Azelf a fast setup option. Preserve the sophisticated trapped-board/dual-speed structure.

TRAINER_MAURA.assessment: Amoonguss actually leads beside Mega Slowbro, establishing redirection plus durable special offense. Wobbuffet traps later, Jynx supplies fast sleep and Starmie immediate special coverage. The plan's opening and dismissive speed/counterplay claims are stale.

TRAINER_SYLVIA.assessment: Indeedee and Sigilyph establish the actual Psychic-pressure opening; Dusknoir and Musharna support a later Commander pair. Tatsugiri and Dondozo retain a genuinely different reserve puzzle. Preserve the contrast, but remove impossible advice to target an already-commanding Tatsugiri.

TRAINER_NATE.assessment: Hypno and Trevenant lead control and physical Grass/Ghost pressure. Cofagrigus can establish Room for bulkier partners, while Mimikyu offers setup and Uxie sustains before Mega Metagross. Preserve the varied defensive opening rather than describe the ace as the lead.

TRAINER_MACEY.assessment: Ferrothorn and Toxapex create immediate contact punishment and anti-setup control. Slowking and Reuniclus sustain, with Delphox and Mesprit adding meaningful special offense. The team is coherent; prose falsely says Toxapex cannot hit Steel and setup automatically wins.

TRAINER_CLIFFORD.assessment: Pincurchin enables Surge Surfer Alolan Raichu immediately. Mow Rotom supplies burns/Grass coverage, Beheeyem a slower Specs mode and Espathra an independent speed ramp. Preserve the terrain puzzle but correct airborne-opponent immunity claims.

TRAINER_NICHOLAS.assessment: Claydol and Contrary Malamar form the real opening. Gothitelle traps in reserve, Aegislash threatens Policy damage and the two dragons supply special force. Preserve the strong six without unsupported claims ranking it second-hardest.

TRAINER_KATHLEEN.assessment: Magic Guard Sigilyph's Flame Orb/Psycho Shift and Espeon's screens form a coherent defensive opening. Veluza, Tyranitar and Dragapult pressure different targets before Mega Latias's recovery/setup finish. Sand chip is an intentional cost, not an automatic defect.

TRAINER_TATE_AND_LIZA_1.assessment: Solrock and Lunatone already restore the twins' iconic opening with real support and Power Herb damage. Cresselia renews Room; Tapu Lele enables Hatterene and Mega Gardevoir's spread finish. Preserve this carefully aligned slow team and its exceptional partners.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_3.assessment: Salazzle's Fake Out/Corrosion supports durable Palossand. Amoonguss adds Pollen Puff healing or Spore and Hypno another control route. Preserve the poisonous Space Center entry puzzle and the distinction between immunity and triggered defense.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_1.assessment: Mightyena's Intimidate and priority support Camerupt's immediate special spread attacks. Shiftry can establish Tailwind or Fake Out and Honchkrow supplies a Moxie pivot. Keep this recognizable Magma quartet with full competitive coordination.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_4.assessment: Torkoal's sun/Eruption and Claydol's Room form a direct engine. Policy Rhyperior and Quiet Magmortar share the slow plan. Preserve the coherent weather/Room opening with lethal pressure from turn one.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_2.assessment: Flygon and Crobat form a safe airborne Earthquake opening with Tailwind/Taunt. Drapion brings critical-hit pressure and Klefki screens/paralysis later. Preserve the opening but make friendly safety explicitly partner-dependent after reserves arrive.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_5.assessment: Room Reuniclus supports Brave Pangoro and Quiet Nidoking. Sandaconda adds a faster Glare/Coil reserve mode, so it need not be forced into the opening Room turns. Keep the distinct physical and special threats.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_6.assessment: Hippowdon and Sand Rush Sandslash supply immediate sand offense. Hustle Durant adds fast physical damage and Claydol gives special coverage with Ground immunity. Preserve a coherent four-member faction roster and safe Ground moves.

TRAINER_GRUNT_SPACE_CENTER_7.assessment: Liepard's Fake Out and Prankster disruption support Incineroar's pivoting. Mamoswine supplies the chief offensive reserve and Miltank sustain/Helping Hand. Preserve the control-heavy lead only with purposeful early offensive replacement when required.

TRAINER_TABITHA_MOSSDEEP.assessment: Gigalith and Landorus supply sand plus immediate special pressure; Steelix guards, Gliscor can add Tailwind and Darmanitan offers Scarf burst. Excadrill has two distinct modes: ordinary Sand Rush and Mega Piercing Drill. Preserve both and repair the false claim that Mega retains Sand Rush.

TRAINER_COURTNEY_MOSSDEEP.assessment: Courtney contributes Ninetales, Great Tusk and Mega Heatran to a combined six-Pokémon opposing multi side. Her sun, physical Protosynthesis pressure and trapping complement Maxie's Primal Groudon/Crobat/Camerupt. Keep three per opponent trainer because this is one combined six-member competition, not a short standalone team.

TRAINER_MAXIE_MOSSDEEP.assessment: Maxie's Primal Groudon, Crobat and Mega Camerupt preserve his signature ensemble within the combined six-member multi fight. Crobat gives both sides of the allied enemy formation Tailwind support, while Courtney supplies complementary threats. Preserve the authored three-plus-three format.

TRAINER_SOPHIA.assessment: Grassy Terrain supports Bulu's healing offense and Lurantis's Contrary Leaf Storm. Oricorio supplies its own Quiver Dance or can copy an opponent's dance; Mudsdale offers Stamina/Body Press. There is no separate allied Quiver Dance donor in this roster.

TRAINER_BENNY.assessment: Noctowl's Tailwind and Tinted Lens pressure complement Magic Bounce Xatu. Leek Sirfetch'd supplies strong physical reserve damage and Cloud Nine Altaria a weather-independent finish. Keep the unconventional birds and accurate critical-hit dependency.

TRAINER_SEBASTIAN.assessment: Scizor's setup/priority is directly supported by Amoonguss redirection. Donphan provides safe physical coverage and Rapid Spin, while Dunsparce sustains through Coil/Roost and spreads paralysis. Body Slam does not flinch; correct that explanation without removing the viable support attacker.

TRAINER_CHASE.assessment: Slowking's bulk supports Defiant Braviary's immediate pressure; Lanturn and Mantine supply distinct immunities and special support. Preserve the bulky opening and the offensive reserve choices rather than automatically add setup.

TRAINER_ALLISON.assessment: Unfezant's critical-hit threat/Tailwind supports Galvantula's accurate Thunder and Electroweb. Crustle offers White Herb Shell Smash and Scyther another physical setup route. Preserve the complementary mixed opening and bug reserves.

TRAINER_REED.assessment: Pelipper and Sharpedo are the actual rain opening; Walrein enters later with Yawn and special attacks, followed by Schooling Wishiwashi. Preserve Walrein's useful reserve role but correct the obsolete opening description.

TRAINER_TISHA.assessment: Lanturn's Icy Wind and pivoting support Slurpuff's special pressure/Helping Hand. Cramorant retains Surf for Gulp Missile and Quagsire is its Water Absorb-compatible partner. Preserve the conditional interaction rather than remove the ability-defining move.

TRAINER_CLARENCE.assessment: Huge Power Diggersby supplies physical pressure beside Competitive Empoleon's special attacks. Swampert adds another Electric immunity and Simipour a Nasty Plot reserve. Keep immediate mixed offense with a genuine alternative setup plan.

TRAINER_RODNEY.assessment: Gyarados's Intimidate supports its Dragon Dance and Wishiwashi's spread pressure. Toxapex can reduce physical damage or poison, while Sharpedo supplies an independent fast reserve. Preserve the two-stage physical offense with a defensive bridge.

TRAINER_KATIE.assessment: Lightning Rod Seaking protects the opening from Electric while Beartic establishes snow. Electivire adds another Electric immunity and Aromatisse supports through Wish/Helping Hand and Aroma Veil. Preserve the manual-weather team and species variety.

TRAINER_SANTIAGO.assessment: Gastrodon and Poliwrath offer complementary Water immunities and mixed attacks. Vanilluxe later establishes snow for accurate Blizzard, while Fur Coat Dewgong contributes speed control and Encore. Preserve a clear Water-to-Ice reserve identity.

TRAINER_RICHARD.assessment: Tauros's Intimidate and immediate damage support Slowbro's actual Calm Mind/recovery set. Exploud adds partner-safe Hyper Voice and Snorlax a slower Curse mode. The team is sound; the plan wrongly claims Slowbro has Helping Hand.

TRAINER_HERMAN.assessment: Bronzong actually leads beside Gourgeist, with slow Guts Heracross, sustaining Florges, Stamina Mudsdale and Mega Crabominable following. The investments consistently serve Room. Keep the complete slow team but remove unsupported superlatives and opener claims.

TRAINER_SUSIE.assessment: No Guard Pidgeot pressures immediately beside Probopass's Wide Guard/paralysis. White Herb Leaf Storm enables Sceptile's Unburden, Boots protect Volcarona, Arcanine offers physical priority and Mega Froslass closes with Snow Warning. Retain Ice Beam for focused, weather-independent reliability; correct the stale claim that Mega Froslass keeps Cursed Body.
